title: Escobar releases ACA resource page for El Pasoans - KTSM 9 News
text:
U.S. Rep. Veronica Escobar launches ACA open enrollment guide for El Pasoans 
 KTSM 9 News 
 Escobar releases ACA resource page for El Pasoans
 Dave Burge 
 2 hours ago 
 EL PASO, Texas ( KTSM ) — U.S. Rep. Veronica Escobar’s Office said it has published an online resource page to help El Pasoans navigate open enrollment for the Affordable Care Act, which runs from Nov. 1 through Jan. 15. 
 “Access to affordable, quality health care is essential for every El Pasoan,” Escobar said. “As open enrollment begins, my office is committed to helping residents find the coverage they need to stay healthy and financially secure. I encourage everyone who is uninsured or looking to renew their coverage to take advantage of these resources and ensure they’re prepared before the January 15 deadline.”
 The webpage includes information on how to enroll through the Health Insurance Marketplace, what documentation is required, how to compare plans, and where to find assistance from local organizations.
 The website can be found here .
